Support

How can we help?

Get support for Capiro and Meri. Choose the category that best matches what you need, then email our support contact.

Email info@capiro.ai

What do you need help with?

A short description of where you got stuck helps us understand your request. Please leave sensitive or confidential information out of your email.

Account access

Sign-in and access issues

Tell us whether the issue is in Capiro or Meri and describe the step where access stopped. Never send a password, one-time code, API key, or access token.

App issues

Something is not working

Include your device or browser, the app version when available, and the steps that led to the issue. Do not include client, meeting, prompt, attachment, or other confidential content.

Privacy and data

Questions about your information

Read the Capiro Privacy Policy for information about our practices. Email us and identify your message as a privacy or data request.

Contact

Contact Capiro support

Use one email thread for follow-up and keep customer or confidential content out of your message.
